releases.notes:
## New
- **ME hatches**: item, fluid and mixed input/output hatches that connect Modern Industrialization multiblocks to an AE2 network, configured per slot like an AE2 interface.
  - Input hatches keep their configured items and fluids stocked from the network. Smart pull sizes the stock to the running recipe, recipe locks configure the slots, and higher-priority hatches are served first.
  - Output hatches push results into the network, either restricted to their configured resources or open to anything. An optional storage cell buffers output (Push mode) or exposes it to the network as extract-only storage at the hatch's priority (Storage mode).
  - Mixed hatches fit wherever item or fluid hatches do. Settings copy with Extended Industrialization's Machine Config Card and the Multiblock Builder. Includes a guidebook page and Jade tooltips.
  - AE2 is optional: without it, placed ME hatches work as plain MI hatches and keep their ME settings.
- Multiblock Builder paste can top up a held Upgrade Stacker with loose upgrades from your inventory or ME network.

## Changes
- Multiblock Builder teardown now drops blocks as if mined with Silk Touch.
- Updated Upgrade Stacker textures.

## Fixes
- Multiblock Builder teardown no longer duplicates machine contents.
- Multiblock Builder paste matches items by their components, fixing an Upgrade Stacker upgrade duplication.
- Vajra mining speed is now constant; potions, enchantments and other effects no longer change it.

## Requirements
- NeoForge 21.1.238+, Modern Industrialization 2.5.12+, Tesseract API 1.12.20+
- Optional: Extended Industrialization 1.16.5+, Applied Energistics 2 19.2.17+

readmeSummary: This mod is also meant to extend the available machines/content in Extended Industrialization.
